user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: View a Wallpaper from the Gallery
proposed_scenarios.description: This scenario validates the primary user path for discovering and viewing content. It starts from the homepage, navigates to the dedicated 'Wallpapers' category, and selects a specific image to view its detail page.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: To ensure users can successfully navigate category pages and view individual content items, which is essential for the platform's core user experience.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a user seeking a new background for my device, I want to easily find the 'Wallpapers' category and click on an image to view it in full detail, so I can decide if it meets my needs.

detailed_steps.description: Load the Unsplash homepage to begin the user journey.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Ensures the primary entry point of the website is accessible and functional.

detailed_steps.description: Click on the 'Wallpapers' link in the main navigation bar to access the curated wallpaper collection.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page successfully navigates to the wallpapers gallery URL.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Critical for category-based content discovery. Failure prevents users from accessing a major content section.

detailed_steps.description: Select and click on a wallpaper image from the gallery to open its detailed view page.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page navigates to the specific photo detail URL.
detailed_steps.business_impact: This is the final step in the content viewing funnel. Failure means users cannot inspect or download images, defeating the site's purpose.

expected_results: User successfully navigates from the homepage to the Wallpapers category.
User is able to select and view the detail page of a specific wallpaper.
The entire workflow completes without any navigation errors or broken links.
edge_cases_to_test: How the page responds if the selected image is no longer available.
Performance of the wallpaper gallery page with a slow internet connection.
Behavior when clicking on various types of images (e.g., portrait, landscape).
data_requirements: No specific user data is required as this is a public browsing flow.
prerequisites: The Unsplash website must be online and accessible.
The 'Wallpapers' category must contain images to select.
